stem_book: If the number of solutions satisfying the equation (sinθ − 1)(2sinθ − 1)(3sinθ − 1)……(n sinθ − 1) = 0 (where n ∈ N) in [0, π] is 9, then find the number of ordered pairs (x, y) satisfying the equation 3 + cosec²x + 2^(sin²y) = n, where 0 ≤ x, y ≤ 4π.
reason: manifest had '2 sin 2 y'; print is 2^(sin²y)
work: 1 + 2(n − 1) = 9 ⇒ n = 5 ⇒ cosec²x + 2^(sin²y) = 2 ⇒ sin²x = 1 (4 x-values), sin y = 0 (5 y-values) ⇒ 20
